This early sampling shifts bits and corrupts 0xa5 to 0xe0; restoring full cfg_divider fixes the bit period.

 				default: begin
-					if (recv_divcnt > (cfg_divider >> 4)) begin
+					if (recv_divcnt > cfg_divider) begin

 						recv_state <= recv_state + 1;
